Berlin’s LawX raises €7.5m to build the backoffice layer of legal AI
items.summary:
Motive Partners is leading the seed round, with WENVEST Capital, xdeck, and SIVentures alongside. The 2025-founded startup is targeting case management, billing, and document handling rather than the parts of legal work most AI vendors are chasing. items.title: Samsung union holds 21 May strike date as Monday mediation opens in Sejong
items.summary:
